construction.name: complete_parent_planar_sector_axial_subdivision_and_whole_child_prefix
construction.proof:
Complete planar dissection composed with axial return

Fix a complete parent packing with actual centers c_i and proper frames R_i. Let q be a positive integer. The q-fold homothetic parent has center q*c_i, original frame, q-fold canonical base and height q*H. For a triangular base, its q-fold enlargement is partitioned into q^2 unit equilateral triangles by the actual barycentric lines at integer mesh levels. Each triangle carries the unique proper in-plane rotation taking the canonical target triangle to that cell; inverted triangles use a pi rotation, not a reflected three-dimensional frame. For a regular hexagonal base, join its center to all six vertices: the six resulting whole equilateral triangles each admit the same q^2-cell subdivision.

If q*H=k*h for an integer k>0, split each planar cell into k complete target prisms at axial slots (j-(k-1)/2)*h. Thus one triangular parent gives q^2*k whole targets and one hexagonal parent gives 6*q^2*k. All outer end costs are exactly those of the q-fold parent. All interior joints are provided by this single full dissection. The retained state includes parent owner index, polygon sector, barycentric cell, axial slot, proper frame and the entire original parent witness. Any requested shorter count is a literal whole-child prefix of the full dissection.

Compare q times the actual parent native scale, including a stated common outward repair, against every current public and retained private target before constructing native coordinates. A predicted gain must come from this jointly realized full dissection, not from independent marginal counts. For native realization, apply one common center dilation and certify every rounded target vertex inside the corresponding homothetic parent, all native child pairs and all host walls. Keep the ideal algebraic cell data so in-plane rotations and their rounding remain reconstructible. No orientation optimization is used.

construction.native_decoder: For ordered parent i, sector a, axial slot j: compute the exact local sector centroid and z=(j-(k-1)/2)*target_height over Q(sqrt(3)). Apply the exact rational parent rotation, add the exact parent native center, and multiply by lambda in that field. For a coordinate u+v*sqrt(3), evaluate float(u)+float(v)*math.sqrt(3) using binary64 operations. This is not asserted to be correctly rounded exact algebraic evaluation. Evaluate the Hamilton product of the original parent quaternion and the declared fixed sector quaternion using binary64 operations. Retain the declared ordered child prefix. All resulting coordinates and quaternion coefficients are then interpreted as their exact binary rationals; exact rounded-child inclusion and direct native all-pair/wall certification cover every evaluation error.
